mechanism: Ferrous sulfate chelates or reduces the bioavailability of zoledronic acid through formation of complexes in the gastrointestinal tract, though zoledronic acid is typically given intravenously reducing this concern; however, ferrous sulfate may impair bisphosphonate absorption if oral formulations are used.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours if using oral bisphosphonates; intravenous zoledronic acid mitigates this interaction, but monitor for adequate therapeutic response and counsel on proper administration timing.
